北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天有霾，体感 2℃，请注意防护和保暖哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Haze and chilly in Beijing, remember to protect yourself and keep warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨，湿度高，出门带伞，注意防潮哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain in Cixi, high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella and mind the dampness.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海中雨天气，体感 11℃，带好雨具，小心路滑。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain in Shanghai, feels like 11℃. Bring your umbrella and watch out for slippery roads.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，但湿度大，穿衣注意舒适透气。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and cloudy, but humid. Dress comfortably and choose breathable fabrics.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 23℃，湿度较高，保持心情愉快！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Shenzhen, feels like 23℃, with high humidity. Stay cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷潮湿，体感 10℃，记得添衣，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is gloomy, cold, and damp, feels like 10℃. Remember to add layers and keep warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 9℃，湿度 100%，小心潮湿与寒意。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Nanjing, feels like 9℃ with 100% humidity. Beware of dampness and cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 17℃，天气舒适，享受美好时光。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 17℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 3℃，湿度高，多穿衣物，别着凉。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is gloomy and cold, feels like 3℃ with high humidity. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感 3℃，湿度 100%，务必注意防寒保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is gloomy and cold, feels like 3℃ with 100% humidity. Be sure to keep warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 13℃，能见度低，出行请注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Chongqing, feels like 13℃. Visibility is low, please travel safely.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴但严寒，体感 -10℃，外出一定多穿！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear but severely cold, feels like -10℃. Bundle up when going out!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾，体感 -5℃，请注意防护，小心着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Haze in Shenyang, feels like -5℃. Take precautions and avoid catching a cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗但有风，体感 14℃，早晚温差大，注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny but windy, feels like 14℃. Mind the big temperature difference between day and night, add layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 17℃，湿度高，出行注意能见度。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Xiamen, feels like 17℃ with high humidity. Pay attention to visibility when traveling.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雨，体感 5℃，出门记得带伞，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Rain in Qingdao, feels like 5℃. Remember your umbrella and keep warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，体感 -2℃，天气寒冷，注意防寒保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Haze in Dalian, feels like -2℃. It's cold, remember to keep warm.
